posts.title: Colorado Would Like You to Know Your Credit Card Is Fine
posts.description: About 100,000 people stored passports, registrations and insurance cards in Colorado's state app. Somebody else has them now. No payment information was involved, though.

posts.title: Update: Samsung Picked the Deadline. You've got 5 minutes till midnight.
posts.description: Three weeks before Samsung's December 15 cutoff, the Home Assistant code that's supposed to replace the SmartThings integration is still an unmerged pull request. Samsung set the dates, sells the required plan in only nine countries, and hasn't answered a question since. Here's what the new setup will ask of you, and why you shouldn't wait to find out how it goes.

posts.title: Samsung Wants $4.99 a Month for the Privilege of Leaving
posts.description: Starting December 15, Samsung will charge SmartThings owners $4.99 a month just to keep their devices connected to Home Assistant, and it's calling every one of them a "developer" to do it. It's the latest in a long line of take-backs from a company that's already killed hubs, Groovy, and long-lived access tokens. Here's what's changing, and why now is the time to move your devices to Home Assistant and stop paying rent on hardware you already own.
